newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DICO SAYS CAN GIVE NO CONCRETE 97 FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: DICO SAYS CAN GIVE NO CONCRETE 97 FORECAST.

text.p: NV DICO International said on Friday it was not able to provide a clear indication of its prospects in 1997 due to difficult-to-forecast conditions in some of its key markets.

"Considering the continuing unclear developments in the for Dico important markets Germany and France, the board does not consider it responsible to give a concrete statement on the expected result in 1997," the company said in a statement.
The beds maker earlier posted a 1996 net profit of 1.05 million guilders, compared with a loss of 5.8 million in the previous year. DICO had said it would return to profit in 1996.
